[EVENT] User plans to update their Twitter profile.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided steps to update the LinkedIn profile, including:  
- Click on profile picture in the top right corner.  
- Select "View profile" from the dropdown menu.  
- Click on "Edit public profile & URL" button.  
- Scroll down to the "Name" section.  
- Click on the pencil icon next to the current name.  
- Enter new name in the fields provided.  
- Click "Save" to save changes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended verifying the name change on LinkedIn by uploading a document.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided steps to update the Twitter profile, including:  
- Tap on profile picture in the top right corner.  
- Select "Profile" from the dropdown menu.  
- Tap on "Edit profile" button.  
- Tap on the "Name" field.  
- Enter new name in the field provided.  
- Tap "Save" to save changes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided optional steps to change Twitter handle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided steps to update Gmail account, including:  
- Click on the gear icon in the upper right corner.  
- Select "See all settings."  
- Click on "Accounts and Import" tab.  
- Click on "Change account settings."  
- Click on "Edit info" next to current email address.  
- Enter new email address and current password.  
- Click "Change" to save changes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to verify the new email address through a verification email.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested updating recovery information in Gmail.
